cohort: 1649 pregnant women with GDM, DIP, or pre-existing T2D in Australia's Northern Territory from 2012 to 2016
finding: Among Indigenous women with GDM/DIP, metformin use was not significantly associated with cesarean section, large for gestational age, or serious neonatal adverse events, although it was associated with earlier gestational age.
mod_finding: Among Indigenous women with gestational diabetes or diabetes in pregnancy, there were no significant differences in cesarean section rates between those who used metformin and those who did not.
